your_book:
Friday was a broadly constructive session for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio sitting on $247 in unrealized gains (+1.08%) against a $23,123 account. The headline mover was NVDA, up +2.93% to $1,310, as whale-alert volume flagged institutional interest; it's one of the cleaner stories in the book with a +9.4% open gain and an 80.4 QARP. The software cluster — NOW (+1.05%, $2,558), ADBE (+1.01%, $2,504), and SAP (+1.51%, $367) — all caught a rotation bid as investors pivoted away from hardware/semis into less capital-intensive software names ahead of Microsoft's earnings. That tailwind is real but event-driven; it can reverse fast. ZTS was the quiet outperformer, up +1.66% to $2,551 on no specific catalyst — steady accumulation in a name the model rates STRONG BUY with an 84.6 QARP.

The drift story is RKLB, and it keeps getting worse. At 14% of the book — the single largest weight — it's down -17.1% from cost, rated AVOID, and scored a weak 45.9 QARP. Friday's +0.42% did nothing to close that gap. Price and thesis are running in opposite directions: the model says avoid, the allocation says overweight. That's the central tension in this portfolio and it hasn't been resolved. LULU (-0.51%, -7.0% open loss) and BSX (+1.59% Friday, but -2.4% open loss with a guidance-slashed flag) are also drifting — both carry elevated risk flags and both sit underwater.

The sharp watch item is NBIX, which cratered -10.08% Friday to $333. It's the only single-day move of that magnitude in the book. It's still marginally above cost (+2.3% open gain) and rated STRONG BUY at 76.2, but a -10% single-session drop without context demands scrutiny before the next session. Also worth noting: NVS slid -1.45% and the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) faces a drug-pricing policy overhang with a flagged date of August 4 — that's Monday.

attention.headline: −10% single-session drop demands immediate diagnosis
attention.note: Neurocrine fell -10.08% on Friday — the largest single-day drawdown in the book by a wide margin — and the cause needs to be identified before markets reopen; the open gain (+2.3%) provides almost no cushion if the move is fundamental.

attention.headline: Largest position is rated AVOID with a −17.1% open loss
attention.note: At 14% of the portfolio, RKLB is simultaneously the biggest weight, the worst open loss, and the lowest QARP (45.9) in the book — a capital-preservation mandate makes this concentration indefensible without a documented thesis override.

attention.headline: Drug-pricing policy event flagged for Monday, August 4
attention.note: The MFN pricing overhang across the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) has a flagged catalyst date of August 4; with NBIX already down hard Friday, any adverse policy headline Monday could compound damage across the entire healthcare sleeve.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed, flat through Q3 — Friday's bounce doesn't fix the thesis
attention.note: BSX popped +1.59% Friday but remains -2.4% underwater with an elevated risk flag citing FY26 growth cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5% and management guiding flat through Q3; a single green day in a structurally weakened story isn't a reason to relax.
